crossRefs.note: When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…

translations.web: The king, and all the people who were with him, came weary; and he refreshed himself there.
translations.bsb: Finally, the king and all the people with him arrived, exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.
translations.kjv: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.
translations.asv: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary; and he refreshed himself there.
